items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: then finally I went and joined Henry Red Allen and I stayed with Red eight years.

ctx.x: And when I came back to New York I met the people that owned the Metropole. That was in '54. And then, after that, I joined...I played...they had a place on Eighth Avenue, over near Madison Square Garden and I played over there for a while,
then finally I went and joined Henry Red Allen and I stayed with Red eight years. Until he died, you know.

But I quit again, out at the Blue Spruce Inn. That's when we made the record "Feeling Good." Now let me tell you about that record. Red and I...I say, "Red, I'm getting sick and tired of you again, so I gotta go." He said, "'Bye." So I went on. Well, that was on a Saturday night, but on Sunday we were off, you know. And Monday he had this recording engagement for John Hammond, "Feeling Good." And I knew that he would get Lannie Scott. And I knew that Lannie didn't know... because if I'd been playing with him…
